alt: Four photos in img/ (a cat, a dog, an elephant and a newly added giraffe) are embedded by the CLIP model openai/clip-vit-large-patch14 into the ImageSearch collection in Qdrant, one point per photo with its filename; api.py keeps the index live, and the query "long neck" returns img/giraffe.jpg first.

run.note: Start the API; it indexes img/ live before it serves
In a second terminal, open the search UI at http://localhost:5173
run.cmd: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
